title: Clock machine step in a state
statement: Let $K$ and $W$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, and let $c$ be a configuration of their clock machine on Boolean input $x$. If the state of $c$ is a state $q$, then one step from $c$ equals applying to $c$ the action prescribed by the clock transition function for $q$, the symbol under the input head, and the symbols under the work-tape heads.
hypotheses_covered: configuration $c$ of the clock machine on $x$
